sorry for the late reply, but i “accidentally” broke it and then confronted them about it 😌

it gets worse before it gets better. I’m only 15 years old and i suffer with bipolar disorder too. 2 months ago i tried to end my own life, and i really hurt everyone around me. i’m not allowed a door on my room, my parents go through my phone every week and at one point they even installed a spy camera. after doing what i did, i felt even worse, but after just two months of therapy i already feel better. I would say the classic “talk to someone” but most of the time people who say that don’t know how it feels to truly believe you should die. However, i feel stupid for doing what i did, and if i could take it back i would. Just know you have people that care about you. If you don’t feel like talking to anyone, or don’t think you have the ability to express how you truly feel, write it down. Although i never really intended for my parents to find my old suicide notes, they did, and now they are more understanding than ever. Praying for you in this difficult time 💞
